title: The paxotopy method for finding isolated roots of a system of nonlinear equations
summary: We focus on systems of nonlinear equations, where some equations are non-polynomial. Building on the remarkable developments in solving polynomial systems during the recent decades, and on a few extensions to specific examples of the transcendental case, a general framework for finding isolated roots is proposed.
